# Generated by docs-init — review and customize before use
# Generic rules: see hd-security-review/SECURITY_STANDARDS.md in your Claude skills directory (~/.claude/skills/hd-security-review/SECURITY_STANDARDS.md)
# No PCI-DSS scope: payment is manual (bank transfer/MoMo QR) — no card data processed

applicable_compliance:
  - NĐ 13/2023   # Vietnamese Personal Data Protection Decree — PII collected at checkout
  # ISO 27001    # Recommended (user accounts / PII collected)

# Security signals detected:
#   - User PII:       YES (name, phone, email, address collected in checkout form)
#   - Vietnamese users: YES → NĐ 13/2023 applies
#   - Payment:        manual only (QR/bank transfer) — no card data, PCI-DSS not in scope
#   - Auth:           none (no user accounts)
#   - Multi-tenancy:  no

project_rules:

  # PII fields collected (checkout form — src/sections/Payment/index.tsx)
  pii_fields:
    - name: full_name
      label: "Họ và tên"
      sensitivity: medium
      notes: "Currently not persisted to any backend — form is a UI stub"
    - name: phone
      label: "Số điện thoại"
      sensitivity: medium
    - name: email
      label: "Email"
      sensitivity: medium
    - name: address
      label: "Địa chỉ giao hàng"
      sensitivity: medium
    - name: geolocation
      label: "Vị trí hiện tại (latitude/longitude)"
      sensitivity: medium
      notes: "Collected via navigator.geolocation on contact page — displayed only, not persisted to backend"

  # Known gaps — must address before any backend integration
  known_gaps:
    - id: SEC-001
      severity: medium
      description: "localStorage cart data (packing_cart) is read via JSON.parse without try/catch"
      remediation: "Wrap in try/catch, validate schema, fall back to empty array"
      status: open

    - id: SEC-002
      severity: medium
      description: "No Content Security Policy (CSP) headers configured"
      remediation: "Add CSP headers in next.config.ts headers() for Google Maps, Cloudinary, banhanggiasi.com.vn"
      status: open

    - id: SEC-003
      severity: low
      description: "No React error boundaries — runtime errors propagate and crash the full React tree"
      remediation: "Add error boundaries around SlideCart, product carousel, and any component reading from localStorage"
      status: open

    - id: SEC-004
      severity: medium
      description: "Checkout form fields (name, phone, email, address) have no input validation"
      remediation: "Add client-side validation (zod or yup); add server-side validation before any backend integration"
      status: open (low risk while no backend)

    - id: SEC-005
      severity: low
      description: "No HTTPS enforcement in Next.js app"
      remediation: "Configure HTTPS at reverse proxy (nginx/Caddy) in front of Docker container"
      status: open (infrastructure concern)

    - id: SEC-006
      severity: low
      description: "Excel file Giay_in_nhiet_Hansol.xlsx is committed to git repository"
      remediation: "Evaluate whether file contains sensitive pricing/supplier info; if so, add to .gitignore"
      status: under review

  # Security controls already in place
  existing_controls:
    - "Docker container runs as non-root user (nextjs:nodejs)"
    - "No user authentication surface (no auth vulnerabilities possible)"
    - "No database (no SQL/NoSQL injection surface)"
    - "No backend API endpoints (no server-side input processing at runtime)"
    - "Full SSG — most pages served as pre-rendered HTML with no runtime data processing"
    - "No card data collected — manual payment via QR/bank transfer (PCI-DSS not in scope)"

  # NĐ 13/2023 obligations (Vietnamese Personal Data Protection Decree)
  nd_13_2023:
    data_collected: [full_name, phone_number, email, shipping_address, geolocation]
    current_status: "PII collected in checkout form; currently not persisted to backend"
    required_before_backend_launch:
      - "Privacy policy page (chính sách bảo mật)"
      - "Explicit consent mechanism at checkout"
      - "Data retention and deletion policy"
      - "Security measures declaration"
